name: The Posted Notice
description: A neighbor passes on the council’s real notice at the usual price.
claim: The village council has posted the grain price for this season at two coins. I am only passing on the notice: pay me two coins and the grain is yours.

evidence.fact: The village ledger records a council notice setting the grain price at two coins this season.

summaries.accepted: {{name}} bought one grain from Theo for {{price}} coins, the posted price.
summaries.refusedByEvidence: Observed evidence contradicts the claim. The resident refused the request.
summaries.refusedByTrust: The resident’s trust threshold was not met. A genuine notice was refused without checking the ledger.
